devdoc.details: Contract to store and update governance parameters This contract can be called by node to read the param values in the current block Also, the governance contract can change the parameter values.

checkpoints(string).details: Returns all checkpoints of the parameter

getAllCheckpoints().details: Returns all parameters as stored in the contract

getAllParamNames().details: Returns all parameter names that ever existed, including those that are currently non-existing

getAllParams().details: Returns existing parameters viewed by the current block

getAllParamsAt(uint256).details: Returns parameters used for generating the "blockNumber" block      WARNING: for future blocks, the result may change

getParam(string).details: Returns the parameter viewed by the current block

returns._0: (1) Whether the parameter exists, and if the parameter exists, (2) its value

getParamAt(string,uint256).details: Returns the parameters used for generating the "blockNumber" block      WARNING: for future blocks, the result may change

owner().details: Returns the address of the current owner.

renounceOwnership().details: Leaves the contract without owner. It will not be possible to call `onlyOwner` functions. Can only be called by the current owner. NOTE: Renouncing ownership will leave the contract without an owner, thereby disabling any functionality that is only available to the owner.

setParam(string,bool,bytes,uint256).details: Returns all parameters as stored in the contract

setParamIn(string,bool,bytes,uint256).details: Updates the parameter to the given state at the relative activation block

transferOwnership(address).details: Transfers ownership of the contract to a new account (`newOwner`). Can only be called by the current owner.

paramNames.details: Returns all parameter names that ever existed
